王野出了练功房，看见王笑笑自己一个人坐在门口的台阶上玩儿。今天何雨水没有来，十多岁的大姑娘了，也是有自己的朋友的。看着小丫头可怜巴巴的，手里还拿着王野给做的竹蜻蜓，这应该是她唯一的玩具了。

王笑笑这时也看见王野出来了，赶紧站起来，一路小跑的向王野跑来。王野看着那两条小短腿儿，生怕她摔倒了，赶紧上前两步，双手张开就把王笑笑抱进怀里。

“大锅，大锅，娘不让，打屁屁！”边说还边指着练功房。这是秦婉知道王野在屋里，不让小丫头去打扰，就让她自己玩的。

王野宠溺的摸着王笑笑的脑袋：“丫头这是等着大哥呢？”

王笑笑使劲的点着头，整个身子都随着点头晃动，好像越用力越显得自己等的着急。

“大哥不让你白等，今天大哥全天陪着你玩，好不好呀？”

“好！大锅，玩儿~大锅好！”

王野举起王笑笑往后一甩，王笑笑就骑到了王野脖子上。王笑笑高兴的不得了，抱着王野的脑袋“咯咯”的笑着。王野对着屋里喊道：“娘，我带着笑笑出去玩儿会儿。”

屋里传来秦婉的声音：“去吧！别走太远。”

王笑笑骑着王野出门了（怎么那么别扭）。整条胡同里都是王笑笑的笑声。出去玩儿，先去哪儿？当然是供销社了！一进供销社，王野就喊：“方姨，我又来了！”

“小野，这是又要给妹妹买糖呀？”

王野空间里其实还有糖，但是这东西没有嫌多的，能买就买点，一次性买太多也不好。

王野拿出一张一斤的糖票，这在当时可是大票了，平常人家里过年也不过买二三两。

“姨，拿一斤水果糖。”

“嚯！小野买这么多呀？”

“就这么一个妹妹，前几天朋友给了这张票，就都给她买了留着吃。”

“你是真惯着她呀！”

“自己的妹妹自己宠，是不是呀？”王野还扭过头问着脖子上的王笑笑。这小丫头见大哥问她是不是，虽然不是很懂，但是仍然奶声奶气说：“是！”

这兄妹的一问一答，逗得方姨哈哈的笑着。

王野在方姨给称糖的时候也没闲着，在供销社里看了起来。这里的东西真是琳琅满目什么都有，针头线脑，衣服鞋帽，吃喝烟酒，甚至连农具都有。王野看见柜台里有几个布老虎，真的很漂亮。看了看王笑笑，就问方姨：“姨，这布老虎用什么票呀？”

“要布票，这个小的只要5寸布票，大的要一尺。”

王野拿出一尺的布票放在柜台上，王野继续四处张望。

接着王野看见了一个帆布包，这是这个年代特有的东西。军绿色的包上有一颗红色五角星。王野前世就有背包的习惯，有点什么东西放在包里，比装在兜里方便很多。可是王野真心看不上这种包。太单一了，王野就想自己DIY一个。

王野就问：“姨，你们这里有帆布吗？就是这种包的布。”

“有呀，你要多少？”

王野看了看方姨拿出来的一匹帆布，这是窄幅布，大概一米五，王野心里算了一下，一个前世用的单肩背包大概得用半平米的布。也不能就做一个吧？多买点，以后万一用的到呢。

王野又拿出五张一尺的布票：“姨，你给我拿五尺吧！”

Wang Ye left the practice room and saw Wang Xiaoxiao playing alone on the steps at the door.He Yuyu did not come today. She is a teenage girl and she also has her own friends.Looking at the pitiful little girl, she still held the bamboo dragonfly made by Wang Ye in her hand. This should be her only toy.

Wang Xiaoxiao also saw Wang Ye coming out at this time. He quickly stood up and ran towards Wang Ye at a trot.Wang Ye looked at the two short legs, fearing that she would fall, so he quickly took two steps forward, opened his hands and took Wang Xiaoxiao into his arms.

"Big pot, big pot, if you don't let me, I'll spank you!" He said while pointing to the practice room.This was because Qin Wan knew Wang Ye was in the house and didn't want the little girl to disturb her, so she just let her play by herself.

Wang Ye patted Wang Xiaoxiao's head lovingly: "Is this girl waiting for big brother?"

Wang Xiaoxiao nodded vigorously, and his whole body swayed as he nodded. It seemed that the harder he nodded, the more anxious he seemed to be waiting.

"Big brother won't let you wait in vain. Big brother will play with you all day today, okay?"

"Okay! Big pot, play~ Big pot is good!"

Wang Ye lifted up Wang Xiaoxiao and threw him back, and Wang Xiaoxiao rode on Wang Ye's neck.Wang Xiaoxiao was extremely happy, holding Wang Ye's head and laughing.Wang Ye shouted into the room: "Mom, I'm going to go out and play with a smile."

Qin Wan's voice came from the room: "Go! Don't go too far."

Wang Xiaoxiao rode Wang Ye out (why was it so awkward).The whole alley was filled with Wang Xiaoxiao's laughter.Going out to play, where to go first?Of course it’s the supply and marketing cooperative!As soon as he entered the supply and marketing cooperative, Wang Ye shouted: "Aunt Fang, I'm here again!"

"Xiaoye, are you buying candy for your sister again?"

There is actually some candy in Wang Ye's space, but there is no such thing as too much. Just buy some if you can. It's not good to buy too much at once.

Wang Ye took out a one-pound candy ticket, which was a big ticket at that time. Ordinary people would only buy two or three taels during the Chinese New Year.

"Auntie, get a pound of fruit candies."

"Hey! Xiaoye bought so much?"

"There is just such a sister. A friend gave me this ticket a few days ago, so I bought it for her to keep."

"You really spoil her!"

"You love your sister, right?" Wang Ye turned his head and asked Wang Xiaoxiao on his neck.The little girl saw her elder brother asking her if she was right. Although she didn't understand very well, she still said in a sweet voice, "Yes!"

The brother and sister's questions and answers made Aunt Fang laugh.

Wang Ye was not idle while Aunt Fang was weighing the candy, and took a look in the supply and marketing cooperative.There is a dazzling array of things here, including needles, thread, clothes, shoes and hats, food, drink, tobacco and alcohol, and even farm tools.Wang Ye saw a few cloth tigers on the counter, which were really beautiful.After looking at Wang Xiaoxiao, he asked Aunt Fang: "Auntie, what kind of ticket do you use for this cloth tiger?"

"If you need a cloth ticket, the small one only needs a 5-inch cloth ticket, and the big one needs a foot."

Wang Ye took out a one-foot cloth ticket and put it on the counter. Wang Ye continued to look around.

Then Wang Ye saw a canvas bag, which was unique to this era.There is a red five-pointed star on the military green bag.Wang Ye had the habit of carrying a backpack in his previous life. Putting something in a bag is much more convenient than putting it in a pocket.But Wang Ye really doesn't like this kind of bag.It was too simple, so Wang Ye wanted to DIY one himself.

Wang Ye asked: "Auntie, do you have canvas here? This is the kind of cloth used for wrapping."

"Yes, how much do you want?"

Wang Ye looked at the piece of canvas that Aunt Fang took out. It was a narrow cloth, about 1.5 meters. Wang Ye calculated in his mind that a single shoulder bag used in his previous life would use about half a square meter of cloth.You can’t just make one, right?Buy more in case you need it later.

Wang Ye took out five more one-foot cloth tickets: "Auntie, give me five feet!"
